# TheWeather.net

> > TheWeather.net is a meteorological information platform operated by Meteored Canada, part of the Alpred Ltd/Alpred S.L. network providing weather forecasts and related services.

The site offers weather forecasting services and is connected to the broader Meteored network founded by Javier Lopez and Juan Jose Martinez. TheWeather.net serves as the Canadian presence for the international weather service platform that originated in Spain in 2000.
